name: MSE 3036
title: Non-Ferrous Alloys
description: Application of materials science and engineering principles to extraction, refining, processing, phase transformations, heat treatment, properties and applications of non-ferrous alloys. Materials covered include alloys of: aluminum, copper, magnesium, nickel, titanium, zinc and refractory metals.
requirement_description: MSE 3001 and 3003, both of which may be taken concurrently. Open to juniors and seniors.
